overview: What's on NHK WORLD-JAPAN. Showcasing various programs and activities of NHK WORLD-JAPAN which provides the latest information on Japan and Asia to the global audience.
title: HELLO! NHK WORLD-JAPAN

overview: Antiques Roadshow Recut features thirty-minute episodes, packed full of favorite finds and paced for maximum entertainment.
title: Antiques Roadshow Recut

overview: Join comedian, raconteur, and musician Bill Bailey as he travels the length of modern Vietnam on the 50th anniversary of the dramatic withdrawal of the US forces from Saigon. Immersing himself in its rich culture, stunning landscapes, and complex history he uncovers what makes this fascinating country tick. From the centuries old hill tribes of the north, to the bustling markets of Ho Chi Minh City and the breathtaking hidden beaches of Ha Long Bay, Bill will show that there is so much more to this country than a legacy of war and conflict. Vietnam is a country that is always looking forward despite its past. Vietnam is unpredictable, chaotic and – at times – infuriatingly bureaucratic… but these are things Bill embraces on a journey no ordinary traveller would dare undertake beyond the tourist trails.
title: Bill Bailey's Vietnam

overview: Premier League Live is live coverage of the games of the day in the Premier League.
title: Premier League Live

overview: Jimmy Carr hosts as Sean Lock and Jon Richardson play the words and numbers game.
title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown

overview: Enjoy an exciting new season of action-packed hunting on L.L.Bean Guide to the Outdoors. Join host Bill Gorman, L.L.Bean's great-grandson, as he takes you on exhilarating adventures to some of the world's premier hunting destinations. Bill has teamed up with JBO Productions' Addicted to the Outdoors and award-winning producer Steve Finch to capture every thrilling moment from beginning to end.
title: L.L. Bean Guide to the Outdoors

overview: We go deep underground and get to follow the people, technology and some of the world's largest machines that keep Sweden's industrial heart pulsating - around the clock, all year round.
title: Gruvan

overview: Cancer Detectives: Finding the Cures explores the pioneering research that could transform the future of cancer detection, treatment and prevention.
title: Cancer Detectives: Finding the Cures

overview: Han Jae-hoon is a wealthy heir who hides his pain behind cold indifference while Kim Hae-jun, a bright art student is burdened by life's weight. What begins as a transactional relationship gradually transforms into a tender bond. In their shared solitude and unspoken care, they slowly draw closer, yet the thing that binds them keeps them from confronting their true feelings. As the tide rises and secrets surface, they must decide: will they remain confined by the rules, or will they dare to love?
title: Tide of Love

overview: You Shu Lang, a director at a pharmaceutical company, lives an ordinary, stable life. But that all comes crashing down after he gets into a car accident with Fan Xiao, the heir to a Thai conglomerate who's returned to China for business. Unlike Shu Lang, Fan Xiao's life has been marred by instability, leading to a twisted, manipulative worldview. When Fan Xiao finds out that Shu Lang is interested in men, he devises plans to entice Shu Lang into a relationship, but ends up falling for Shu Lang for real. Shu Lang, on the other hand, is blindsided when he learns about Fan Xiao's true colors. Will Fan Xiao destroy the only genuine love he's ever had, or can he find a way to truly win Shu Lang's heart?
title: To my shore

overview: Set in 1920s Yongxin City, the mysterious death of an antique shop owner and the theft of priceless relics ignite a tense battle. Singer Du Qing, Detective Hanzhou, and Luo Ting must overcome mistrust and work together to protect the artifacts and outwit powerful enemies.
title: Running Hunters

overview: When loyalty to country becomes loyalty to a lie, one teen risks everything to expose the truth. With the Gestapo closing in, he must decide what it really means to be a good German. This four-part series expands on the film.
title: Truth & Treason

overview: In the 1930s, two sisters separated by destiny face prejudice and sexism: one from the big city's high society, the other from a group of renegades in the back country. Emilia is romantic and marries a rich young man who is full of secrets. Luiza, of a wilder nature, falls in love with an outlaw who provokes mixed feelings in her. In this feminine and intimate epic, the sisters know they only have each other and both will surprisingly leave their marks in the world.
title: Entre Irmãs

overview: Born deep in the Rocky Mountains stands a man today who reaches 6'7 and 270 lbs of solid mountain man. He hunts and survives as the mountain men did in the mid-1800s. Born of Indian ancestry and trained by true Mountain Men, Laramy "Sasquatch The Mountain Man" Miller uses only a hand made bow and a traditional .54 caliber Hawken Rifle to travel the route the mountain men did. From deep in the Canadian Rockies to the plains of the Midwest hunting, trapping and surviving off the land. He does it all the hard way, the "Sasquatch" way – in a world of high-tech hunters, weapons and technology, Laramy "Sasquatch" Miller, shows us what real hunting and living in the great wilderness truly is.
title: Sasquatch Mountain Man

overview: After his wife vanishes following a deadly accident, Rohith reports her missing. When police find her, he insists the woman isn't really his wife.
title: Shodha

overview: From a modest beginning to becoming the most powerful family in the world, the Basmacigiller struggles to protect their top place.
title: Sekizinci Aile

overview: San Francisco 49ers dynasty, during the 1980s and early 1990s, a struggling football team transforms into the sport's most dazzling and successful franchise, becoming the talk of the league.
title: Rise of the 49ers
Я готова отдать за сына ВСЁ!

overview: Sex, Money, Murder is an eight-part true crime docuseries exploring a string of murders that shook communities across the U.S. from the late '90s to the mid-2000s. Each episode investigates a different case, but every trail leads back to one common thread: the strip club. Packed with secrets, shocking twists, and betrayals you'll never see coming, this is where lust, cash, and blood collide.
title: Sex, Money, Murder

overview: Hard follows the misfortunes of Sophie, a middle-class housewife from a French Catholic bourgeois upbringing. Following the sudden death of her husband, Sophie uncovers a dark secret about his lifestyle.
title: Hard

overview: Four friends in their early twenties fumble their way through minor and major disasters on their journey into adulthood. They want to be "strong, independent women" — it's just a bit exhausting to be that all the time.
title: Basic Bitch Bærum
Frier und Fünfzig – Am Ende meiner Tage

overview: Reality documentary with Yeliz Koc and Jimi Blue Ochsenknecht: Will the former lovers find their way back to each other as parents to their daughter Snow?
title: Yeliz & Jimi – We Are Family?!

overview: One chaotic day, psychologist Nisse forgets confidential medical records on the bus. A total disaster. He loses his job and is relegated to a job in Dalarna and a position at the health center in Gagnef. Not much to live for, Nisse thinks. But the charming Rebecka at the hardware store still brightens up Nisse's everyday life, until he suddenly meets her in her role as a couples therapist.
title: Parterapi i Gagnef

overview: They may live in the smallest state in the country, but their drama? Extra large. Bravo is expanding the distinguished franchise with The Real Housewives of Rhode Island, spotlighting a fresh, charismatic group of women whose lives intertwine across the storied coastline of New England luxury.
title: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island

overview: This series follows a tight-knit group of Persian friends who have traded Beverly Hills for suburban life in the Valley. Rooted in their culture that values family, friendships and loyalty above everything else, emotions often take over as these fiery personalities navigate their highs, lows and everything in between.
title: The Valley: Persian Style
Bai Fen Bai Xin Dong Ni

overview: Follow the adventures of Professor Ian Hood, Special Advisor to the government's Joint Sciences Committee, who troubleshoots threats stemming from or targeting "scientific endeavour". He is joined by Rachel Young, a Special Branch operative who acts primarily as his bodyguard, as Hood has made powerful enemies through his work.
title: Eleventh Hour

overview: What happens to songs once written by an artist but never finished or released? Simon Keizer gives these songs a second chance by commissioning another artist to create a new, unforgettable version.
title: Onvergetelijke Liedjes

overview: 7de Laan is an extraordinary microcosm where good and bad, evil and wholesome characters find themselves forming part of a wholesome community where no matter what, everyone counts and everyone cares.
title: 7de Laan

overview: A series of youth dance competitions ignite friendships and dreams.
title: To the Beat!

overview: In the past, Sergey Rashidov was a successful surgeon who, by coincidence, had to radically change his profession and even his name. Now he is Djura's janitor, forced to live on forged documents. During the morning cleaning, he finds a wounded bandit named Conrad. Filled with medical duty, Rashidov provides him with first aid, and then secretly treats him in his janitor's room. Major Alyoshin, an employee of the homicide department, becomes aware of the circumstances of the shooting, and Konrad's rival, the leader of a criminal group, the owner of a nightclub nicknamed Lucky, finds out where Konrad himself is. Fearing revenge, Lucky decides to blow up a competitor's car and find and punish the doctor who helped Conrad.
title: Лепила

overview: Sompho has lived with her single mother Nongnuch since birth. They have to contend with a sharp-tongued landlord, Paula. Working at a resort, Sompho meets Kumpha who was sent to look after two VIP guests. There's a misunderstanding and, thinking her a thief, Kumpha nearly turns Sompho in to the police.
title: Lucky Swan

overview: Emma Brody is a young, single all-American woman who leaves behind her dysfunctional family in Toledo, Ohio to take a job as the vice consul at the U.S. Embassy in London, England where she squares off against her no-nonsense boss, Elque Polk, and has a meeting of minds with CIA attache Doug Roach and her new co-workers in dealing with various political cases.
title: The American Embassy

overview: Steal is a contemporary, high-octane thriller about the heist of the century and the ordinary office worker, Zara, who finds herself at the heart of it. A typical work day at a pension fund investment company, Lochmill Capital, is upended when a gang of violent thieves burst in and force Zara and her best mate Luke to execute their demands. But who would steal billions of pounds of ordinary people's pensions and why? DCI Rhys is determined to find out, but as a recently relapsed gambling addict, Rhys must keep his own money problems at bay while dealing with the secret agendas and competing interests at the center of this far-reaching crime.
title: Steal

overview: The 1% Club Rollover works the same way as the original show, but if the prize pot is not won on one show, it will rollover to the next day's show. If all the pots rollover, there could be up to £500,000 being up for grabs!
title: The 1% Club Rollover

overview: Iyanla: The Inside Fix will bring Iyanla's fresh perspective to twelve of the most impactful episodes, exploring how the challenges we face and the ways we heal have evolved in today's fast-changing world. This new series invites viewers to reflect, reframe and reconnect with the lessons that still matter most.
title: Iyanla: The Inside Fix

overview: In the setting of the Toronto-based investment house, Gardner/Ross, Traders explores the intimate lives and loves, the mystique and monetary machinations of investment bankers whose high-stakes decisions and sizzling alliances can have grave international consequences.
title: Traders

overview: This is the story of a web novelist who's found great success in her career, yet failed miserably in love. One day, she meets a beautiful model—a woman who makes her fall in love at first sight and sparks her desire to open her heart again. Even though her best friend warns her this woman is dangerous, known for her scandolous affairs and casual relationships, she refuses to believe it. She's convinced that if she shows enough kindness and love, she can change her. As their relationship develops and she does her best to love sincerely and give selflessly, she often forgets to be kind to herself. As her partner continues in her ways, she chooses forgiveness rather than to walk away. One day, however, a shocking truth forces her accept the truth of her situation.
title: Club Friday Theory of Love: Merit Wins the Soul

overview: A Patagonian town is shaken by the arrival of Letizia, a foreign woman preparing to marry a powerful local businessman. Her presence arouses suspicion, but no one suspects the truth: she is the key to a bloody revenge plot. With everyone's trust, she sets her plan in motion and commits the most brutal crimes in a town that hides more secrets than it seems.
title: Hija del fuego: la venganza de la bastarda

overview: At his uncle's funeral, Jeonghan is reunited with Iljo, a man he hasn't seen in years. It turns out Iljo's struggling to stay afloat. Stirred by pity and charitable impulse, Jeonghan invites Iljo to move in with him. The problem is that Iljo catches feelings like a match to fuel. To top it off, Jeonghan isn't keen on dating him, but somehow, he's a pro at accidentally making things a lot messier for everyone involved. Is this a love story in the making, or a disaster waiting to happen?
title: Thundercloud Rainstorm

overview: "Hirunoyume Another Side" (昼のゆめ another side) is a spin-off drama within a fictional drama that aired on TV Tokyo. It's a key part of the narrative of the series "25:00, Akasaka de Season 2" (25時、赤坂で Season2). The spin-off, "another side", focuses specifically on the plot and characters of this fictional show "Hirunoyume" itself. While only fragments of "Hirunoyume" are shown in the main series, "another side" reveals the entire story of the show-within-a-show.
title: Hiru no Yume another side

overview: Sevdiğim Sensin tells the story of Dicle, a village girl whom Istanbul native Erkan saves from his cruel brothers by marrying her during his military service, and their journey that extends to Istanbul. Believing in this marriage with her pure heart, Dicle steps into Istanbul's glittering yet harsh world, unaware of the planned marriage Erkan's family wants for him.
title: Sevdiğim Sensin

overview: Galicia, 1900. Two girls, Clara and Catalina, are born at the Pazo de Espíritu Santo. Clara belongs to the maid, Renata, while Catalina is the daughter of the Valdés family, Don Gustavo and Doña Inés. An unexpected act of revenge will shake the lives of these girls and all those around them, forcing Doña Inés to survive heartbreak and the pain of abandonment. She will also have to navigate the power struggles to make her true daughter the heir to an empire, in an era when women were not allowed to be masters of their own destinies.
title: Las hijas de la criada

overview: 17-year-old Wen Hai lost his parents in an accident. Since he was underage, the court appointed his wealthy half-brother, Gu Huaizhou—whom he had never met—as his guardian. Gu Huaizhou despised Wen Hai's arrival and treated him with cold cruelty. Though Wen Hai appeared obedient, he secretly resented the abuse. Gu Leng manipulated Wen Hai's emotions to take revenge on Gu Huaizhou, but his schemes backfired. During this time, Gu Leng also became entangled with debtor Jiang Nan, whose resistance turned into love and ultimately ended in tragedy. Meanwhile, Wen Hai and Gu Huaizhou's relationship shifted from hostility to reluctant reconciliation and forbidden attraction. Yet their bond was shadowed by blood ties and moral boundaries they could not escape. Eventually, after Gu Leng drugged Gu Huaizhou, everything between them shattered.
title: Gu Jinnan Prisoner

overview: Joe Turk is a veteran police sergeant, husband and father of four adult children. Two of his children are cops, one is on the other side of the law and the youngest is a struggling college student. Joe tries to keep his family together and remain loyal to his wife, Mary despite his growing attraction to Ginny, a local waitress.
title: Turks

overview: José Ramón Garrido is a former Olympic badminton player who now works as a physical education teacher at a public school in Vallecas. Divorced and disillusioned, he discovers in a school tournament a teenage player, Mar, who could be his ticket to fulfill his dream of competing in Yakarta, the city where former players like him are respected as stars.
title: Yakarta

overview: Shen Wanqing, condemned as "impure" after spending four years in prison, was ruthlessly hunted down by the Liu family for the sake of their reputation. After being reborn with a new face as the merchant's daughter Lan Mengyan, she marries into the Liu household to exact her revenge, using herself as bait to capture the hearts of both father and son. To make the Lius pay, Lan Mengyan deliberately walks into danger, until Qin Moxiu, who has been secretly watching over her, can no longer sit idly by...
title: Gorgeous Dream

overview: Join Renee Montgomery along with Kel Mitchell and Jesser as they come in and work behind the scenes to surprise local youth and sports teams.
title: Play It Forward

overview: Qin Yu, the newly appointed top scholar, marries Zhang Qiong, the notorious 'shrew' known for miles around, to repay a meal she treated him to three years ago. Unexpectedly, this sets off a life-and-death situation entangling both domestic strife and court politics. Qin Yu, who appears gentle and frail on the surface, is actually a covert royal agent entrusted with the crucial task of investigating corruption in disaster relief efforts. The bold and fearless Zhang Qiong fights with wit and courage against her ruthless uncle to protect her younger sister. The couple work hand in hand with one heart to benefit the people.
title: Top Scholar, Your Wife's at It Again!

overview: "¿Apostarías por mí?," a new multiplatform reality show, broadcast live 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The show will challenge 12 celebrity couples who will give up their privacy to live completely exposed as they face tests, bets, and temptations on their journey toward one goal: proving how far they're willing to go for each other. The couple that earns the audience's votes and proves they can overcome it all will take home up to $300,000.
title: ¿Apostarías por mí?

overview: Across four immersive episodes, K-Everything follows Daniel Dae Kim on a quest to discover how South Korea has sparked a global pop culture movement, driving trends in music, food, TV and film, and more. From Busan to Seoul, Kim will trace the roots of Korean culture featuring cameos from some of the biggest names driving South Korea's creative renaissance.
title: K-Everything

overview: Some of Australia's finest musical talent grace the stage with the sounds of the festive season for an enchanting Christmas. Featuring Eddie Perfect, Cody Simpson, Casey Donovan, Justine Clark, Tim Draxl, Jason Arrow and more.
title: A (Very) Musical Christmas

overview: The Şerzanoğulları are one of Mardin's oldest and most powerful tribes. The wealth and influence they have amassed over the years have made them a prominent family not only in the region but throughout Türkiye. However, at the core of this empire lies dark secrets, deep wounds, and broken lives. A story with deep roots and a burning heart. On one side, secrets linger in the shadow of the past. On the other side is the burning price of love. But, the silent walls of stone mansions will no longer hide secrets. With scenes shot in the captivating atmosphere and on the enchanting cobblestone streets of Mardin, the series isn't just a story. It's the rebirth of a legacy, a betrayal, and a passion. In this world where love, legacy, and revenge intertwine, nothing will be as it seems. The years-old feud between two long-established families is now reignited in a completely different form. Amidst that reckoning, a forbidden love blossoms. In each episode, viewers will step into the world of characters who battle both the past and the voice of their hearts. Zerhun isn't just a love story...It's a profound journey that will make you question the heavy price of reputation, prestige, and legacy. Every scene features heart-wrenching moments that will leave you glued to the screen. Because Zerhun isn't just a series... It's a story of destiny.
title: Zerhun

overview: Lydia DeLucca is a New Jersey bartender who wants more out of her life than just marriage and kids. So she breaks off her engagement, and heads to college. This doesn't make her ex-boyfriend Lou happy, who thinks she is wasting her time getting an education. Her family is none too supportive either. Her mother, Dolly, thinks marriage would be better since she thinks Lydia can't take care of herself. Her dad, Frank, cares more about the New York Giants than Lydia's psych term paper. But that's life...
title: That's Life

overview: Dustfall is a propulsive, atmospheric Tropic Noir that follows a detective whose deep sense of justice is challenged by a world where victims are doubted, predators hide in plain sight, and the legal system too often falls short. When seasoned detective Tig, returning to her hometown of North Gap after years in the city, uncovers a string of drink spiking assaults, the case is turned on its head when one of the main suspects is murdered.
title: Dustfall

overview: Democrats are looking to regain power, and whether it is the urgency for generational change, the right approach to fighting back or the issues that should be front and center, there is a whole lot of warranted debate about what a winning formula looks like. "The Blueprint" is a forum where those discussions take place. MS NOW's Jen Psaki sits down with some of the biggest names on the left side of the political spectrum to talk about confronting Trump 2.0 and how the Democratic party can succeed at shaping the future they'd like to see. This is a space for thought-provoking, honest discourse where Jen goes beyond political talking points to determine "the Blueprint" for what lies ahead.
title: The Blueprint with Jen Psaki

overview: In a dying opal town in the middle of the desert, law and order are little more than myths. Thieves raid the mines, zealots preach salvation to the lost, and billionaire magnates play god. When a miner is found beheaded and left to decompose in the depths of his own small claim, big-city homicide detective Ivan Lucic is sent to investigate. Assigned to him is former local constable Nell Buchanan, who knows how this place really works — and how it warps people. Together, they're drawn into a labyrinth of secrets, greed, and old sins that won't stay buried. As the case twists into something darker and more surreal, Ivan and Nell can't tell whether it's the town that's unravelling or themselves
title: Treasure & Dirt

overview: From street eats to elegant restaurants, Justine Schofield explores the dynamic flavours of Hong Kong. Join her as she samples iconic dishes, meets local culinary masters, and brings the taste of Hong Kong into her own kitchen.
title: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield

overview: Jasmine Harman's no stranger to helping others find their perfect place in the sun. Now she and her family take the plunge and transform a run-down villa into their new home on the Costa del Sol.
title: Jasmine Harman's Renovation in the Sun
